text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired PD-9281 inference.europe.high-errors — 5xx spike (1200 errors in 5m). Autopage route: eu-prod. 

maria: acked, i'm eu oncall, joining. customer-facing dashboards show 503 bursts for EU customers, spike started ~08:03 UTC.

simon: i'm available, swapping rotation. i'll take ownership if you want to hand off, maria.

maria: thanks. taking ownership now, pinging customer success. quick triage: errors show 'model-unavailable' on dedicated pools, 2/6 pods OOMKilled.

jess: tag:infra — looks like autoscaler didn't spin quickly. checking hpa and node pressure. running:
```bash
kubectl get hpa -n inference
kubectl describe pod inference-eu-2``` 

ashley: I can spin a temporary dedicated pool in eu-west-1 and shift routing. prepping infra, ETA ~6m.

maria: ok plan: 1) scale dedicated pool (ashley), 2) enable fallback routing to us-west for high-latency tolerant routes (simon), 3) add temporary circuit breaker returning 429 for overloaded slots to reduce retries. notify customers.

simon: starting routing change now — enabling eu->us fallback for model variant v2-small. will post status.

ops-runner: NOTE: customer visible impact ~20% EU requests 503/timeout. CS notified and posted interim status.

jess: HPA shows CPU at 95%, stall due to pod OOMs. increasing limits on replica set and bumping node group.

ashley: new pool spun, adding to LB. hitting healthchecks... 2/3 healthy so far.

maria: confirmed new instances healthy, traffic shifting. error rate trending down. continuing to monitor, will keep PD updated. tagging #postmortems for follow-up.

simon: handoff to maria complete. i'll standby until metrics stabilize. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: PD-9281 acknowledged by maria. Escalation suppressed. Autopage resolved when error rate <5% for 2m.
